description:
Declare YOUR character's INTENT: what they do, say or want right now. Call EXACTLY ONCE, then finish work immediately.

        |An intent is a DECLARATION to the world, not a description of what happened: whether it succeeds, how others react and how it all ends is decided by the master. Write from the character's viewpoint and from what they know.
name: declareIntent

intention.description: INTENT: what the character does and/or says — concretely, in their voice, 1-4 sentences. Direct speech is welcome. No results, reactions of others or check outcomes: you declare an attempt, not its success.

motivation.description: MOTIVATION: why it wants this — one or two lines for the master. The player will not see it, it does not enter the world; write plainly, including what the character is hiding.

description: Transition to another state (phase) of work. Call it once the current phase's work is complete — as the LAST call of the SAME response that finishes that work (when the phase rules allow the transition). The switch is applied at the END of this response: every other call in the same response still runs in the CURRENT phase, so it is safe to finish the phase's work and request the transition together. Do not spend a separate response on a lone transition call, and do not place new work AFTER the transition expecting the new phase.
name: transitionTo
